content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD 인프라(경계·초기화·MPI·IO·전역변수) 전수분석 노트 — src/bc.F·init.F·parallel.F·io.F·samples.F·statistics.F·nesting.F·misc.F·mod_global.F·mod_param.F·mod_input.F 전수 read(L5). §1 bc.F(L14-L18): BOUNDARY_CONDITION(:53) 4방향 개방경계 P·Q=0와 Fx=0.5g(ξ²Γ3+2ξ·Deps), MASK<1 flux 처리, ABS/LEFT_BC_IRR 서경계 skip; EXCHANGE(:426) 매 step 주변수(Eta·U·V·HU·HV·MASK·AGE·nu_break) ghost 교환+MASK 곱+FILTERING 시 SHAPIRO_3; PHI_COLL(:631) VTYPE 6종 ghost+PERIODIC+phi_exch; PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH(:539) 비표준크기 mirror. §2 init.F(L20-L23): ALLOCATE_VARIABLES(:54) 전 2D 배열 할당; INITIALIZATION(:280) 구면격자(Lat_theta·Dx·Dy·Coriolis)·MUSCL kappa(SEC→−1/else→1/3)·수심(DAT/FLA/SLO)·PHI_COLL ghost·BATHY CORRECTION·WaterLevel·DepthX/Y·Cd(In_Cd)·초기파형·WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION·CALCULATE_SPONGE·MASK/MASK9·COUPLING_INITIAL·EtaBlowVal; INITIAL_UVZ(:1283) 초기 Eta/U/V/MASK 파일읽기. §3 parallel.F(L25-L28): phi_exch(:55) 2D real ghost 비동기교환(MPI_IRECV/ISEND/WAITALL, E-W len=Nloc·Nghost, N-S len=Mloc·Nghost); phi_exch_variable_length(:184)/phi_int_exch(:314, INTEGER); DISTRIBUTE_VarGlob(:446) rank0 전역배열→PHIGLOB→로컬블록 MPI_ISEND 분배. §4 io.F 13 subr(L30-L34): OUTPUT(:52) dispatcher(SCREEN_INTV→STATISTICS, PLOT_INTV→PREVIEW, station, VESSEL/SEDIMENT/FOAM 카운터); READ_INPUT(:149, 5065줄 최장) input.txt 전체 파싱+RESULT_FOLDER 생성; PREVIEW(:4304) 필드출력(eta_00001 5자리→PutFile)·PREVIEW_MEAN(:4630) 시간평균(Hsig·Sxx); STATIONS(:3786 Cart/:4132 Sph) 시계열(time,eta,u,v)→ASCII; GetFile(:4751)·PutFile(:4863/:4894 ASCII/binary). §5 samples.F 11 subr(L36-L38): SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY(:56) a/cosh²; INITIAL_GAUSIAN(:258, INI_GAU) AMP·exp(−r²/WID²); INITIAL_RECTANGULAR(:173, INI_REC); INITIAL_DIPOLE(:347, INI_DIP); INITIAL_N_WAVE(:439, Tadepalli-Synolakis); INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE(:511, INI_SOL Nwogu)+SUB_SLTRY(:582 Newton 계수). §6 statistics·nesting·misc(L40-L45): STATISTICS(statistics.F:52) MassVolume·Energy(0.5gH²+0.5u²H)·MaxEta·Froude+CHECK_STATISTICS(:192 NaN→MPI_ABORT); COUPLING_INITIAL(nesting.F:53)/OneWayCoupling(:357) parent grid 경계 시계열 선형보간→ghost; INDEX(misc.F:54) MPI_CART_CREATE(PX×PY)·이웃 rank·iista/iiend·Mloc 식; ESTIMATE_DT(misc.F:216) CFL DT식+MPI_ALLREDUCE(MIN); MAX_MIN_PROPERTY(:307)·CHECK_BLOWUP(:394, |Eta|>EtaBlowVal→중단)·SHAPIRO_3(:479, a1=44/64 저역필터). §7 전역상태(L47-L50): GLOBAL(mod_global.F:52) 주변수·수심·flux·MUSCL·분산미분·시간미분·분산중간·MASK·쇄파·SPONGE·통계·MPI 변수 열거, 분산제어 gamma1/2/3(g3=0 선형SWE)·Beta_ref=−0.531·Nghost=3; PARAM(mod_param.F:53) SP precision(DOUBLE→8/else SELECTED_REAL_KIND(6,30)), grav=9.81·pi·R_earth=6371000·RHO_WATER=1000·RHO_AIR=1.15·SMALL=1e-6, 공유 I/J/K/tmp1~5; INPUT_READ(mod_input.F:53) READ_INTEGER/FLOAT/LOGICAL/STRING KEY=VALUE 파싱+CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE. §8 전체 호출 흐름 다이어그램(L52-L58). §9 연결(L60-L61): code-graph·source-map·dispersion-solver·flux-tvd·physics-sources·feature-modules.
